import hashlib, json, os, tempfile, time
from pathlib import Path
runs=[]
expected=None
for repeat in range(3):
    for label in (['j04','j05'] if repeat%2==0 else ['j05','j04']):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='mus-review-prior-') as tmp, tempfile.TemporaryFile(mode='w+') as output:
            command=[f'build/review-{label}/release/mus-solver','--format','ordago-score','--score','35:35','--iterations','1000','--evaluation-samples','10000','--seed','7','--threads','1','--preload-ordago','/tmp/mus-review-j05/generic.cfr','--continuation',str(Path(tmp)/'table')]
            start=time.perf_counter()
            pid=os.posix_spawn(command[0],command,os.environ,file_actions=[(os.POSIX_SPAWN_DUP2,output.fileno(),1)])
            _,status,usage=os.wait4(pid,0)
            if status: raise RuntimeError(status)
            elapsed=time.perf_counter()-start
            output.seek(0)
            stdout=output.read()
            hashes={p.name:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sorted((Path(tmp)/'table').iterdir())}
            if expected is None: expected=hashes
            row={'variant':label,'repeat':repeat+1,'seconds':elapsed,'peak_rss_kib':usage.ru_maxrss,'command':command,'file_hashes':hashes,'files_equal_to_first_baseline':hashes==expected,'stdout':stdout}
            runs.append(row)
            Path('/tmp/mus-review-j05-prior.json').write_text(json.dumps(runs,indent=2)+'\n')
            print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in row.items() if k not in ['stdout','file_hashes','command']}),flush=True)
